newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end down, see sluggish week.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end down, see sluggish week.

text.p: Austrian shares on Monday shrugged off gains from a late rally on Friday to end lower, in spite of a bullish international market.

The ATX index of 21 blue-chip shares ended down 3.19 points or 0.3 percent at 1,073.53, off an intraday high of 1,078.61. Among its components eight ATX shares closed higher, 12 lower, and one was unchanged.
Traders said there was little room for strong gains over the next few days unless volumes picked up.
"We put in a good performance on Friday but we must not exaggerate it," said one trader.
"We could see some correction around 1,060 but that would not be tragic," another said.
Strong resistance in the ATX is seen at 1,080 points.
Traders said international investors were currently few and far between on the Vienna bourse, lured away by more promising opportunities elsewhere.
"It looks as if international investors are well enough served by Germany and the United States," said one.
Fibre maker Lenzing was the day's leading decliner, down 13 schillings or 1.84 percent at 692.0
The October ATX future dropped nine points to 1,071.0.
The broad-based Vienna Bourse index shed 1.30 points to close at 413.21.
